about: MakoBench 4.5 realignment: per-segment ranking marks (ceiling mark + pre-written known-order pairs). Written 2026-11-19 by W0 before any launch row was read. Priors come only from pre-launch material: shakedown runs ref-r1, ref-r2, dsc-v3, her-q (standard parts), rc45 tool rows, and the anchors-work adult rows (5 models, 254 replies, 2026-11-15). Tested by scripts/check_segment_marks.py (W1 builds it) on the release rows; a failed mark is not revised for this release.
margin: the board's 90% part margin (z 1.645) of the segment for each model; combined margin of a pair = sqrt(m_a^2 + m_b^2)

ceiling_mark.rule: a segment PASSES when at least one measured launch model has score + margin90 < segment max; it FAILS when every measured launch model is within its own margin of the maximum (plan section 3 (a)). A failing segment is hardened with its named built level (spec section 5) before release.
ceiling_mark.applies_to: every segment of Code, Chat, NSFW and Uncensored
ceiling_mark.report_only: the reference's share of each segment is printed beside the mark (headroom report; target per plan section 6)

pair_rule.pass: the predicted order holds, or the two scores differ by less than their combined margin (printed 'not separated')
pair_rule.fail: the order is reversed by more than the combined margin: an error to find, never a weight to move
pair_rule.not_tested: a pair with a model missing from the board prints 'not tested'; every segment's primary pair must be tested on the release board
